package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const (
	SubjectCoursePlanCompleted   = "course.plan.completed"
	SubjectCoursePlanFailed      = "course.plan.failed"
	CoursePlanOutcomeSchemaV1    = 1
	CoursePlanOutcomeSchemaV2    = 2
	CoursePlanSourceTeacher      = "TEACHER"
	CoursePlanSourceStudent      = "STUDENT"
	CoursePlanSourceSystem       = "SYSTEM"
	CoursePlanStatusCompleted    = "COMPLETED"
	CoursePlanStatusFailed       = "FAILED"
	maximumPlanNotificationRunes = 2000
)

var ErrInvalidCoursePlanOutcome = errors.New("invalid course plan outcome")

type CoursePlanAuditRefs struct {
	DialogID          string `json:"dialog_id,omitempty"`
	SourceMessageID   string `json:"source_message_id,omitempty"`
	TeacherDecisionID string `json:"teacher_decision_id,omitempty"`
}

// CoursePlanOutcome is the bounded Learning Planner-owned terminal result.
// It contains business status only, never generated prompts or reasoning.
type CoursePlanOutcome struct {
	EventID        string
	EventType      string
	RequestID      string
	CausationID    string
	StudentID      string
	OccurredAt     time.Time
	LearningPathID string
	Status         string
	ResultCode     string
	CourseID       string
	Reused         bool
	FailureCode    string
	Source         string
	Reason         string
	AuditRefs      CoursePlanAuditRefs
}

func NormalizeCoursePlanOutcome(input CoursePlanOutcome) (CoursePlanOutcome, error) {
	input.EventID = strings.TrimSpace(input.EventID)
	input.EventType = strings.TrimSpace(input.EventType)
	input.RequestID = strings.TrimSpace(input.RequestID)
	input.CausationID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CausationID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.LearningPathID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningPathID)
	input.Status = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(input.Status))
	input.ResultCode = strings.TrimSpace(input.ResultCode)
	input.CourseID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseID)
	input.FailureCode = strings.TrimSpace(input.FailureCode)
	input.Source = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(input.Source))
	input.Reason = strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(input.Reason))
	input.AuditRefs.DialogID = strings.TrimSpace(input.AuditRefs.DialogID)
	input.AuditRefs.SourceMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(input.AuditRefs.SourceMessageID)
	input.AuditRefs.TeacherDecisionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.AuditRefs.TeacherDecisionID)
	input.OccurredAt = input.OccurredAt.UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)

	if !validUUID(input.EventID) || !validUUID(input.RequestID) || !validUUID(input.CausationID) ||
		!validUUID(input.StudentID) || input.OccurredAt.IsZero() || len(input.ResultCode) > 64 ||
		(input.LearningPathID != "" && !validUUID(input.LearningPathID)) || (input.Source != CoursePlanSourceTeacher &&
		input.Source != CoursePlanSourceStudent && input.Source != CoursePlanSourceSystem) ||
		(input.Reason != "INITIAL" && input.Reason != "REPLAN") {
		return CoursePlanOutcome{}, ErrInvalidCoursePlanOutcome
	}
	if (input.EventType == SubjectCoursePlanCompleted) != (input.Status == CoursePlanStatusCompleted) ||
		(input.EventType == SubjectCoursePlanFailed) != (input.Status == CoursePlanStatusFailed) {
		return CoursePlanOutcome{}, ErrInvalidCoursePlanOutcome
	}
	if input.CourseID != "" && !validUUID(input.CourseID) {
		return CoursePlanOutcome{}, ErrInvalidCoursePlanOutcome
	}
	if input.Status == CoursePlanStatusFailed {
		if !validCoursePlanFailureCode(input.FailureCode) {
			return CoursePlanOutcome{}, ErrInvalidCoursePlanOutcome
		}
	} else if input.FailureCode != "" {
		return CoursePlanOutcome{}, ErrInvalidCoursePlanOutcome
	}
	for _, value := range []string{input.AuditRefs.DialogID, input.AuditRefs.SourceMessageID, input.AuditRefs.TeacherDecisionID} {
		if value != "" && !validUUID(value) {
			return CoursePlanOutcome{}, ErrInvalidCoursePlanOutcome
		}
	}
	if input.AuditRefs.SourceMessageID != "" && input.AuditRefs.DialogID == "" {
		return CoursePlanOutcome{}, ErrInvalidCoursePlanOutcome
	}
	return input, nil
}

// Planner failure codes are terminal machine-readable identifiers. Keep the
// consumer bounded and opaque to future code additions while rejecting values
// that cannot be the producer's upper-case underscore code form.
func validCoursePlanFailureCode(value string) bool {
	if value == "" || len(value) > 64 {
		return false
	}
	for index := 0; index < len(value); index++ {
		character := value[index]
		if (character < 'A' || character > 'Z') && (character < '0' || character > '9') && character != '_' {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

type CoursePlanNotification struct {
	Outcome           CoursePlanOutcome
	PersonalTeacherID string
	Body              string
	DialogMessageID   string
	AcceptedAt        time.Time
	DeliveredAt       *time.Time
}

func NormalizeCoursePlanNotification(input CoursePlanNotification) (CoursePlanNotification, error) {
	outcome, err := NormalizeCoursePlanOutcome(input.Outcome)
	if err != nil {
		return CoursePlanNotification{}, err
	}
	input.Outcome = outcome
	input.PersonalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PersonalTeacherID)
	input.Body = strings.TrimSpace(input.Body)
	input.DialogMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogMessageID)
	input.AcceptedAt = input.AcceptedAt.UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)
	if !validUUID(input.PersonalTeacherID) || input.Body == "" || len([]rune(input.Body)) > maximumPlanNotificationRunes ||
		input.AcceptedAt.IsZero() {
		return CoursePlanNotification{}, ErrInvalidCoursePlanOutcome
	}
	if input.DeliveredAt == nil {
		if input.DialogMessageID != "" {
			return CoursePlanNotification{}, ErrInvalidCoursePlanOutcome
		}
	} else {
		deliveredAt := input.DeliveredAt.UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)
		input.DeliveredAt = &deliveredAt
		if !validUUID(input.DialogMessageID) || deliveredAt.Before(input.AcceptedAt) {
			return CoursePlanNotification{}, ErrInvalidCoursePlanOutcome
		}
	}
	return input, nil
}
